item.title: Another Long One Folks! — Sun Nov 8, 10:30 AM
item.description:
These Boots Are Made for Hiking **Meetup Point: 155 Rowntree Mill Rd, North York, ON M9L 2K1** **Steeles Avenue West and the Humber River, where it connects with Thackeray Park off Kipling Avenue/Steeles Avenue**
Join Honey for a scenic, full length hike along the Humber River through parks, wooded valley sections, wetlands, the Old Mill area and down to Lake Ontario at Humber Bay Arch Bridge, We will hike the 20.4 km point-to-point route from the north to south following the park. It's not a difficult hike but it is long.
**If you are a beginner this might not be the hike for you as the pace is steady and the distance is far.** Come prepared with good walking shoes, lots of water, snacks and layers as who knows what the weather will be like.
Note: We are like the postman. Rain or shine we hike!
Source: Meetup: These Boots Are Made for Hiking

item.title: From Modernization to Innovation: Building AI-Ready Foundation for Your Business — Tue Nov 10, 12:00 PM
item.description:
Microsoft Reactor Toronto Modernizing an application is more than moving it to the cloud—it creates the foundation for what comes next.
In this session, we’ll take a modern application from cloud-native architecture and GitHub-powered development workflows through to an AI-enabled experience with Microsoft Foundry.
Along the way, we’ll explore how managed identity, automation, observability, and cost-aware AI patterns help you move from experimentation to scalable, production-ready innovation. --------------------------------------------------------
Check out the series - https://aka.ms/ModernizefasteSeries
[eventID:27686]
Source: Meetup: Microsoft Reactor Toronto

item.title: Building AI solutions for small businesses with Microsoft 365 Copilot — Tue Nov 10, 2:00 PM
item.description:
Microsoft Reactor Toronto Artificial intelligence is no longer just for large enterprises. Microsoft 365 Copilot gives small businesses access to AI-powered tools that can help improve productivity, automate routine tasks, and free up time to focus on growth. In this introductory session, attendees will learn how Microsoft 365 Copilot integrates with familiar Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
Through practical demonstrations and real-world business scenarios, participants will discover how Copilot can help create content, analyze data, summarize meetings, manage email, and streamline everyday workflows. The session also introduces best practices for responsible AI adoption, effective prompting, and identifying business processes where AI can deliver immediate value. Attendees will leave with a clear understanding of how to get started with Microsoft 365 Copilot and where to continue learning through Microsoft Learn and official Microsof
